verdict.rationale: AgentMail is an email provider, so internal collaboration on messages is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no internal comment threads or @mentions attached to a message. Labels, cc/bcc for human oversight, and draft review are adjacent features that do not provide a side-thread discussion.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
